metadata.title: Malformed User Agents Incident Handler
metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel playbook for the Malformed user agents detection rule. Enriches the incident IPs against AbuseIPDB, drops IPs below the report threshold and allowlisted ISPs, and — when anything is left — server-side clones the OPSLSY Technical change template (via CloneIssueDetails.jspa, so the Insight/Assets Affected item is carried intact), creates a run-record sub-task, walks the change to Implementation, appends the kept IPs to the Palo Alto blocklist blob, attaches the AbuseIPDB CSV, walks the change to Post implementation review and assigns it to SecOps for manual close, then closes the Sentinel incident. No human approval gate. The Logic App's system-assigned managed identity requires: Microsoft Sentinel Responder on the workspace, Key Vault Secrets User on the Key Vault, and Storage Blob Data Contributor on the blocklist storage account.
prerequisites: Key Vault secret '<JiraKeyVaultSecretName>' holding the Trackspace service account password.
Storage account hosting the blocklist with $web/index.html present (static website enabled).
Trackspace template change '<TemplateIssueKey>' reachable by the service account.
AzureSentinel and KeyVault API connections (this template creates them if absent).
OMS-owned AbuseIPDB API connection 'abuseipdbapi-1' already authorised; this template references it and does not create or modify it.

fields.description:
*GOAL:* Block malicious IPs flagged by the Malformed user agents Microsoft Sentinel detection rule
*Root-cause:* Sentinel incident @{triggerBody()?['object']?['properties']?['incidentNumber']} reported source IPs whose AbuseIPDB totalReports is at least @{parameters('MinReports')} and whose ISP is not on the excluded-ISP list.
*Time frame:* in optimal case approximately 5 minutes
*Accurate start time:* @{outputs('Compute_Run_Times')['displayStart']}
*Accurate finish time:* @{outputs('Compute_Run_Times')['displayFinish']}
*Affected Service:* Palo Alto Fws
*Impact:* Not expected.
*Tested:* OPSLSY-37786
*Communicate and contact:* LSYH, BUD NETOPS and LSYH, BUD SECOPS
*Rollback:* Remove IP(s) that cause problem from External dynamic deny rule named - Sentinel_Threat_Intelligence_IPs

Blocked IPs can be found in the attachment.
